description: «Resource busy» on a project's calendar in a window: kind 'busy' — two occurrences ('a', 'b') need one resource at times that overlap once its buffers are counted — or kind 'repair' — an occurrence ('a') needs a resource under repair — or kind 'move' — the reconfiguration before 'b' has no time to happen, because 'a' holds a unit it moves or the room it is done in while it should be done: a conflict without the two overlapping. Cancelled and paused occurrences take nothing. Any member may read.

to.description: Window end, ISO 8601. Default: a week after the start; at most 400 days.

name: list_calendar_conflicts
title: List calendar conflicts
